name: usb-net
description: Universal ASIX USB-Ethernet for MMI3G+ / RNS-850. Ships a devn-asix driver that supports AX88772 / 772A / 772B / 772C (+ 88178 and Linksys/NetGear rebadges) by activating Harman's own AX88772B init path from later firmware. Brings up the link + telnet; 'lte' mode also sets DLinkReplacesPPP so the unit uses the USB adapter for online services. Loads from USB only — never modifies the read-only firmware.
author: dspl1236
scripts: usb_net_run.sh - load universal ASIX driver, bring up link, telnet; modes dhcp/static/lte

hardware.adapter: Any ASIX AX88772 / 772A / 772B / 772C USB-Ethernet (modern cheap 772B/C now supported)
hardware.router: Any router/switch on the adapter (DHCP), or direct cable to a PC (static)

values.label: Static 172.16.42.1 — direct cable to a PC

notes: Validated on a Porsche PCM 3.1 (issue #7); MMI3G+/RNS-850 use the same QNX 6.3 io-net SH4 driver ABI and the driver is itself from MMI3G+ MU9498 firmware, so it is expected to work — pending an Audi/VW bench confirmation. Supersedes the lte-setup module (now deprecated): its old AX88772B/D overrides never worked on io-net.
